description: Get a shipment by shipmentId: purchased rate, costs, addresses, tracking number, label URL, and cancellation status (Logistics API getShipment). Logistics API is limited release (eBay-approved developers only, USPS rates and labels only) and needs the https://api.ebay.com/oauth/api_scope/sell.logistics scope, which is not requested by default: eligible keysets add it to EBAY_OAUTH_SCOPES and re-consent.
name: ebay_get_shipment
